title: Suspension, Reactivation and Resource Overage on Web Hosting Plans
content:
## Web Hosting Plans: suspension and reactivation

**Non-payment.** A plan whose term has ended unpaid keeps running for the tier's grace days (calendar days) after the term end date and is suspended for non-payment on the following day.

**Reactivation window.** A plan suspended for non-payment may be reactivated only on or before the suspension date plus the tier's data retention days in calendar days. The window adds whole calendar days to the suspension date, counting the day after it as day 1, and the last day is included, after which the plan is terminated and its files deleted. The suspension date is the one on the plan's hosting record, and the reason recorded there must be non-payment for this window to apply.

**Reactivation after non-payment.** Reactivation after non-payment requires the renewal under the renewal rules plus the tier's reactivation fee. A reactivation fee may be charged only while the plan status is suspended.

**Resource overage.** Usage at the tier's warning level (a percentage of the inode or storage limit) triggers a warning notice, and usage over a limit triggers an over-limit notice; a plan still over the limit the tier's overage cure days (calendar days) after the over-limit notice is suspended for resource overuse.

**Overuse and malware.** A plan suspended for resource overuse or malware is reactivated, without any fee, once usage is back within limits or the malware has been cleaned, and its term dates are never changed by a suspension.

### Dates worked through (hypothetical, with a 5-day grace and a 14-day retention)

| Event | Date |
|---|---|
| Term end date, unpaid | 10 August |
| Last day the plan keeps running | 15 August |
| Suspended for non-payment | 16 August |
| Day 1 of the reactivation window | 17 August |
| Last day reactivation is possible | 30 August |
| From the next day | plan terminated, files deleted |

| Suspension reason | Reactivated when | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| non-payment | renewal paid plus reactivation fee, within the window | reactivation fee |
| resource overuse | usage back within limits | none |
| malware | malware cleaned | none |
